title: Three Seasons and One Short Whistle
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：recreation　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recreation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the coach ① offered the recreation that no player in the field would have recorded, and he said the offering was the whole of the season. The ② recreation, meaning the leisure itself and not the whistle, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; recreation, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of recreation in that field had the same short whistle beside it, and the ④ recreation at the far stand, meaning the goal they kept for the children to cheer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Recreation, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the coach said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the recreation was the whole of the matter, meaning the pleasure and not the leisure. The ⑥ recreation, meaning the pleasure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; recreation, he said, is either something you offer or the only word that means both leisure and a pleasure. He said the pleasure is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ recreation had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short whistle. The ⑧ recreation of the whole thing, the coach wrote in April, was one field and three seasons of recording; recreation, he said, is either the goal at the far stand or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ recreation I remember is the recreation recorded in the record, which closed in 2001 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Recreation, my mother said in 2003, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all recreation, she said, is a pleasure that has agreed to look like leisure. She said the pleasure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 娱乐；消遣（指球场里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 娱乐；消遣（指那种娱乐本身，与小小的哨子相对）
C. 固定搭配：offer the recreation 提供这一种娱乐
D. n. 娱乐；消遣（指留给孩子们喊的那一个）
E. n. 娱乐之事（抽象总称，指一处球场的娱乐之事）
F. n. 娱乐；消遣（指赛事记录里写到、被记载的那一种）
G. n. 娱乐、兴致（指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 兴致（抽象总称，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: offered the recreation that no player in the field would have recorded
The recreation, meaning the leisure itself and not the whistle
Every sort of recreation in that field
the recreation at the far stand
the recreation was the whole of the matter
the recreation had become a line in a record
The recreation of the whole thing

answers.why: offer the recreation 意为“提供这一种娱乐”，1994 年那位教练把球场里没有一位队员肯记载的一种娱乐做了一遍。
recreation 意为“娱乐；消遣”，指那种娱乐本身而不是小小的哨子，它经过了三个赛季而在簿子上没有被记载。
recreation 意为“娱乐；消遣”，指球场里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的哨子。
recreation 意为“娱乐；消遣”，指最远那面看台的留给孩子们喊的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
recreation 意为“娱乐、兴致”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种兴致就是那件事的全部。
recreation 意为“兴致”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种娱乐，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
recreation 意为“娱乐；消遣”，指赛事记录里写到、被记载的那一种，到 1999 年这一种成了赛事记录里的一行。
recreation 意为“娱乐之事”，教练四月写道，整件事的娱乐之事是一处球场和三个赛季的记载。
recreation 意为“娱乐；消遣”，我记得的是赛事记录里记载过的那一种，2001 年打完了，至今仍被说成球场里最安静的一种。
recreation 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，娱乐是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的娱乐。
